items.title: Tor amplitude adds over the derived tensor product of complexes over two rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the tor amplitude of the derived tensor product of a complex over one ring with a complex over another ring as the sum of the two intervals, and the proof is a 21-line argument combining a reduction, a triple complex identity and a spectral sequence. It first replaces the first complex by a bounded complex of flat modules in the given interval, then for an arbitrary module over the base ring chooses a free resolution, identifies the triple tensor product with the total complex of a double complex whose second factor has cohomology concentrated in the second interval, and finally applies the spectral sequence of that double complex to bound the cohomology of the whole tensor product by the sum of the intervals. Each of the three ingredients is displayed.
